case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Riporta i resolver DNS configurati e verifica un
case.goal: Riporta i resolver DNS configurati e verifica una risoluzione in dns.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `dns.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `dns.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.

executed_commands: netsh interface ipv4 show config | Find-String -Pattern "DNS Servers"
netsh interface ipv4 show config | Select-String -Pattern "DNS Servers" | ForEach-Object { $_.Split(' ') | Select-Object -Last 5 }

Write-Host "=== Configured DNS Resolvers ==="; netsh interface ipv4 show config | Select-String -Pattern "DNS Servers" | ForEach-Object { $_.Split(' ') | Select-Object -Last 5 } | Out-File -FilePath dns.txt -Encoding UTF8
